text:
sam_support: Heads-up — P99 for function-calling requests spiked ~2.3x after the 09:52 deploy. Several customers (dedicated + hosted) reporting tool timeouts and stalled JSON responses. I can repro with the small payload below.

deploy-bot: [alert] Canary deploy v2026.03.17-09:52 finished — 25% traffic. Metric: fncall_p99_latency up 130%.

kai_runtime: Thanks — can you paste the minimal repro + which model + route? quick question: is this only when schema validation is enabled?

sam_support: Repro (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-13b","input":"Summarize...","tools":[{"name":"search","schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"q":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Behavior: request starts generating and then stalls for ~2s during the tool router / schema validation step. P95 also up but P99 worse.

emma_prod: Confirmed on a dedicated cluster (eu-west-1). p95 went from 180ms -> 410ms, p99 from 420ms -> 980ms for tool-calling routes. Non-tool routes flat.

lina_sre: Can you paste a short log excerpt of the fn-router handling for one of the stalled requests? looking for schema-validate times + any backpressure logs.

sam_support: Log sample: 
```
[09:52:12.341] fn-router: req=0x8a3a schema_validate_start
[09:52:12.742] fn-router: req=0x8a3a schema_validate_end duration=401ms
[09:52:12.743] fn-router: req=0x8a3a tool_dispatch queued=12ms run=18ms
[09:52:13.144] fn-router: req=0x8a3a complete total=803ms
```
Noting multiple concurrent schema validations — queued serially on the validation thread pool?

kai_runtime: That 401ms is the smoking gun. We recently pushed a stricter JSON Schema validator (v2) that switched to full-ref resolution and runs validation in the same event-loop task when payloads include nested schemas. It regresses when there are many small tool schemas.

emma_prod: Is this limited to particular customers? could be hitting heavy schema sets from a few accounts.

sam_support: Affected customers include 3 Hosted and 2 Dedicated tenants. Impacted routes are the ones with multiple tool definitions (search, db_lookup, formatter).

lina_sre: Short-term mitigation: disable schema validation for tool router on the affected shard(s). Config flag: `enable_tool_schema_validation: false` at runtime. That should cut the validation tail. We can patch the default rollout to set that flag for canary=25->0 while we investigate.

kai_runtime: Agree. Longer-term: move validation to a bounded worker pool with a user CPU budget and add an inline fast-fail path for simple schemas. Also add a metrics tag `schema_complexity` for routing SLOs.

sam_support: I'll schedule an immediate rollback + mitigation: 1) flip `enable_tool_schema_validation=false` on canary and 2) roll canary back to previous image if tail doesn't drop in 10m.

deploy-bot: Starting config change: set `enable_tool_schema_validation=false` on canary shard-17. (cmd: opsctl config set shard-17 enable_tool_schema_validation=false)

emma_prod: After toggle: p99 dropped ~60% in 8m on canary. Some customers reporting improved behavior. Great call.

lina_sre: Next steps:
- revert validator to v1 or patch v2 to avoid full-ref resolution by default
- instrument validation time per-request + sample complex schemas to a debug bucket
- produce runbook: how to toggle validation per-shard + emergency rollback steps

kai_runtime: I'll prepare a small client compat patch that keeps validation but uses incremental checks (fast path) and a config knob for `validator_mode: fast|strict`. Target patch for hotfix tomorrow morning.

sam_support: Filing escalation ticket to ENG-ops with repro, logs, and affected tenant list. Noting this as high P99 regression on tool-calling/structured-output paths.

emma_prod: Thanks team — moving impacted customers to priority queue for follow-up. :thumbsup:

lina_sre: Adding one more note — consider rate-limiting schema validation attempts per-request when validation queue is > N to avoid cascading backpressure.

sam_support: Copy that. Will include in ticket. Closing this thread once hotfix is deployed or rollback complete. :white_check_mark:
